comments:
Blurred seal on the cover page and annotation 5(80), as well as the indication that fol. 19 is missing - all of those likely from the library that preserved the manuscript. 
No signature is visible on the reproduction, but [6TNNKSQ3]: 66 reports the 'Bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang signature phyi tsa 62 and indicates that the manuscript is now preserved at the library of Zha lu monastery.

After the colophon, in the same handwriting, one finds the mention of the owner, a lineage ending with the author's successor Phyogs las rnam rgyal (ID:4214), and a verse by the scribe.
